title: 第10章 出宗门那天，就是你的死期
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
掌门说完“此案到此为止”之后，议事殿里安静了好一会儿。

    陈元站在原地，脸上青一阵白一阵。

    刚才还义正辞严地指控林尘修炼魔功，转眼就被四位长老轮番反驳，连他最寄予厚望的周长老也只是不痛不痒地提了个“走个流程”，最后还被掌门一句话否了。

    妈的，这群老家伙，一定是提前得到了什么风声。

    一个个得就知道见风使舵，临时反水的戏路可真不少。

    陈元气得牙都要咬碎了，眼珠子直直地瞪着几位长老，心里面更是把他们祖宗八辈给问候了一遍。

    从椅子上站起的时候，又因为肾上腺素飙升，大脑充血，差点没一个前倾倒地。

    半晌后，陈元才从恼怒的状态恢复过来。

    那四位长老呢？当然是各忙各的，准备跑路。

    钱长老正收拾着桌上的测魔盘。

    他把那面银色圆盘小心翼翼地放回木盒子里，盖上盖子。

    收拾完东西，他站起来，看了陈元一眼，嘴唇动了动，终究什么都没说。

    孙老拄着竹杖站起来，竹杖点在石板地面上发出笃笃的响声。

    他路过陈元身边时脚步不停，只是摇了摇头。

    那双半眯着的眼睛里有失望，也有无奈。

    赵长老把那本泛黄的考核记录册子揣回怀里，站起来走到陈元面前。

    两人对视了一瞬，赵长老开口想说什么，但看到陈元那张铁青的脸，叹了口气，转身走了。

    周长老最后一个站起来。

    他额头上的汗还没擦干，低着头快步从陈元身边走过，连看都不敢看一眼。

    刚才他那个“走个流程”的提议被掌门直接否了，两边都没讨到好，现在只想赶紧离开这个是非之地。

    几个长老陆续出了殿，没人跟陈元搭话。
content_en:
After the leader said, "This case ends here," the meeting hall was quiet for a while.

    Chen Yuan stood there, his face turning blue and white.

    Just now he had justly accused Lin Chen of practicing magic skills, but in the blink of an eye he was refuted by the four elders in turn. Even Elder Zhou, who he had the highest hopes for, just casually mentioned "go through the process", and was finally rejected by the headmaster.

    Damn it, these old guys must have gotten some information in advance.

    Every one of them knew how to adapt to the changing circumstances, and there were a lot of dramas about temporary betrayal.

    Chen Yuan was so angry that he almost gritted his teeth. He stared at the elders with his eyes straight and greeted the eight generations of their ancestors in his heart.

    When I stood up from the chair, due to the surge of adrenaline and congestion in my brain, I almost fell forward.

    After a while, Chen Yuan recovered from his angry state.

    What about the four elders? Of course, everyone is busy with their own affairs and ready to run away.

    Elder Qian is packing away the magic measuring disks on the table.

    He carefully put the silver disk back into the wooden box and closed the lid.

    After packing his things, he stood up, glanced at Chen Yuan, moved his lips, but said nothing in the end.

    Mr. Sun stood up with his bamboo stick, which made a sound when it touched the stone floor.

    He didn't stop walking when he passed Chen Yuan and just shook his head.

    There was disappointment and helplessness in those half-closed eyes.

    Elder Zhao put the yellowed assessment record book back into his arms, stood up and walked to Chen Yuan.

    The two looked at each other for a moment, and Elder Zhao opened his mouth to say something, but when he saw Chen Yuan's livid face, he sighed and turned away.

    Elder Zhou stood up last.

    The sweat on his forehead had not yet been wiped dry, and he walked quickly past Chen Yuan with his head lowered, not even daring to look at him.

    Just now, his suggestion of "going through a process" was directly rejected by the leader. Neither party got anything good from it. Now he just wants to leave this place of right and wrong as soon as possible.

    Several elders left the hall one after another, and no one spoke to Chen Yuan.
title_en: Chapter 10 The day you leave the sect is the day you die.
